hypotheses.reasoning: From 21:27:29, enrichment-svc's calls to the geo-IP provider started failing fast with 502/503 errors. At 21:28:55 enrichment-svc's circuit breaker opened (#121), so it began returning 503 to ingest-api (#138). The gateway then returned 503s to clients. At 21:40:23 a half-open test call to the provider still got a 502 (#174), so it hadn't recovered. The gateway disk warning (#15) is unrelated.
Possible alternative reading, but the logs show fast failures, not timeouts.

verdict.recommendedAction: Escalate to the geo-IP provider and check their status page. Meanwhile, let enrichment-svc skip the geo lookup or use cached geo data so POST /v1/events doesn't fail with 503. Clean up the /var/log disk on the gateway separately.
